mintAuthority.summary: A7A5 has two canonical native issuance deployments, on Ethereum and Tron. Old Vector LLC's minting and redemption run off-chain through KYC-gated authorized partners against RUB deposits; on-chain, the Ethereum token's issue() function is owned by a 3-of-5 custom multisig (5 EOA signers), and the Tron token's owner is a 3-of-5 Multisig contract (5 EOA signers). Both native tokens are direct immutable deployments with no proxy or other mint-logic upgrade path. Ethereum wA7A5 is a same-chain parent-backed representation and is excluded from Mint Authority; it holds parent A7A5 already counted inside the canonical Ethereum total, and its catalog route entry was withdrawn 2026-09-01 with the wrapper finding preserved in the Bridge Risk profile summary.

controls.label: Old Vector LLC issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated primary-market mint/redeem: Old Vector LLC creates A7A5 supply against custodied RUB bank deposits via KYC-verified partners (e.g. a7a5.kg); no on-chain permissionless mint exists.

controls.label: A7A5 ETH token owner (custom 3-of-5 multisig)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095800 (2026-10-01), owner() on A7A5 Ethereum (0x6fa0be17e4bea2fcfa22ef89bf8ac9aab0ab0fc9) returned 0x7d2d47e441915ff9c2d5a6e4a7aadd5e02722e29. getOwners() returned the same five signers (0x6dab4c10135618a41d4a88d46bb045d58b518e58, 0xae8dd5dd7dce988c100e04d2e7d0806f770f4638, 0x8b04bdc073adc337d64dccf5009de52153ffb5e0, 0x99d3df8c2ad2aeef67148453d1544f9dfa6a72c1, 0x3353d63ae04411fe2f9bb803c7b84b59f091d593) and getThreshold() returned 3. The token's EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were zero. The earlier 2026-07-13 review found no modules or guard; that extension-surface finding is historical and is not newly established by these owner and threshold reads.

controls.label: A7A5 Tron token owner (3-of-5 multisig)
controls.evidence: At Tron block 83506136 (2026-06-11): owner() on A7A5 Tron (TLeVfrdym8RoJreJ23dAGyfJDygRtiWKBZ) returns TML1DbrPXYDDwatGxw66iEwECnXCG54uJy, which is a Tron Multisig contract. getOwners() returns 5 owner hex addresses; getThreshold()=3. All 5 owner addresses resolve as non-contract EOAs on Tron.

review.evidence: Historical control observations are preserved without renewal: Ethereum block 25526129 (2026-07-13) identified the custom 3-of-5 token-owner multisig with five EOA owners, immutable owner/compliance/accountant values, no upgrade function, and zero implementation/beacon slots. Tron block 83506136 (2026-06-11) identified its separate 3-of-5 owner; the July review recorded a verified non-proxy runtime without DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. Both issuer-controlled native issue paths remain economically unbounded. Ethereum wA7A5 is a same-chain parent-backed wrapper, not another native liability. The September 1 research recorded two historical 2025 reserve-report leads, including a July 4 report signed September 26 under ISAE 3000, but neither original was retrievable and its auditor attribution was disputed between Kreston and Anderson. Those historical leads do not establish current attestation supervision or recurring reconciliation. FD21 source review on 2026-10-20 recovered the issuer's relocated English documentation, linked from the live a7a5.io website: docs-en.a7a5.tech/legal/transparency.md contains only a transparency statement and licensed-distribution claim; its complete llms.txt index has no financial reserve-report page; a7a5.io/transparency shows token distribution rather than a reserve schedule; audit.pdf is a 404 HTML page. The recovered Terms section 4.3 still describes deposits and short-term assets without reserve weights, banks or a reconciliation procedure. The recovered FAQ confirms one A7A5 equals one RUB and redemption through platforms/accredited agents but gives no reconciliation cadence. No current whole-liability reconciliation or independent financial engagement was found. Nondisclosure and failed report retrieval do not positively prove that no reconciliation regime exists, so the former none value is corrected to unknown; the unsupported current attestation-only supervision annotation is likewise unknown. The verified Ethereum source retrieved on 2026-10-20 still exposes uncapped onlyOwner issue(address,uint256), and no favorable cap/process credit is granted.
